Record Class Tree.StringParser.Configuration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.ericmedvet.jnb.datastructure.Tree.StringParser.Configuration
Record Components:
childrenStartDelimiter - the regex for initial delimiter for the list of children
childrenEndDelimiter - the regex for final delimiter for the list of children
childrenSeparator - the regex for separator for the list of children
allowVoid - a flag for setting whether to accept empty content before a match
Enclosing class:
Tree.StringParser<L, NT extends L, T extends L>
public static record Tree.StringParser.Configuration(String childrenStartDelimiter, String childrenEndDelimiter, String childrenSeparator, boolean allowVoid) extends Record
A configuration for a StringParser, specifying what regexes to use as initial delimiter for the list of children, final delimiter, and inner separator.
